prompt:
Create a 3:4 vertical ultra-realistic street-fashion advertising photo where a real person appears to pull a music-player phone interface out into the real world. The subject is a young East Asian woman with fair skin, soft natural makeup, dark brown hair in a loose messy bun with wispy bangs, standing centered in front of a muted gray-blue vintage double door on a city street in daytime natural light. Use a high-angle wide selfie-like perspective from slightly above and in front of her, with mild wide-angle distortion. She looks directly at the camera with a gentle smile and reaches one hand toward the lens, palm open and very close to the viewer, creating strong first-person interaction and shallow depth of field. She wears a fitted light gray cropped T-shirt, high-waisted light blue denim shorts, white socks, chunky white sneakers, and a slim brown shoulder bag. Background should be softly blurred but recognizable: paneled blue-gray door, stone wall edges, sidewalk pavement, bright sun and soft shadows.

Surround her with exactly 5 floating translucent glass music-player UI cards, as if smartphone app panels have detached from the screen and are hovering in physical space. All cards are semi-transparent dark frosted glass with rounded corners, thin pale outlines, glossy reflections, subtle refraction, realistic perspective, and cast faint shadows/occlusion against the scene. Each card contains album art, track title, artist name, progress bar, time stamps, cast icon, and playback controls with white minimalist icons. Count and place the 5 cards as follows: 1 large card in the lower left foreground, closest to camera, tilted in perspective, showing sunset ocean album art and the text Echoes in Waves with artist "Haycoon" and duration around 4:18; 1 medium card in the upper left showing black-and-white portrait-with-flowers album art and the text "Midnight Drive" by "Velora"; 1 medium card in the upper right showing pink cloud album art and the text "Cloud Eight" by "Lume"; 1 medium vertical card on the right side showing black-and-white windy portrait album art and the text "Fading Signals" by "Noir"; 1 small card in the lower right showing blue abstract album art and the text "Lumen" by "Astra". Keep the floating panels integrated into the lighting and perspective so they feel physically present around the woman rather than flat overlays.

Visual style: hyperrealistic live-action photography, creative commercial ad aesthetic, crisp skin and fabric detail, natural daylight, gentle lens flare, soft bokeh, realistic shadows, high dynamic range, no cartoon styling. Composition should emphasize depth: the reaching hand is large and slightly blurred in the foreground, the subject's face is sharp, and the UI cards float at different distances around her. Avoid extra people, extra UI cards, watermarks, captions outside the cards, distorted anatomy, unreadable gibberish text, or a purely graphic mockup look.

promptZh:
创作一张 3:4 竖屏超写实街头时尚广告照片，画面中真人仿佛将手机音乐播放器界面拉入现实世界。主体为 一位皮肤白皙、妆容自然清透的年轻东亚女性，深棕色头发扎成随性的丸子头，留着轻薄的空气刘海，白天在自然光下，站在城市街道一扇灰蓝色复古双开门前。采用略高于视线、从前方拍摄的广角自拍视角，带有轻微的广角畸变。她直视镜头，面带温柔微笑，一只手伸向镜头，手掌张开并非常靠近观众，营造出强烈的沉浸式互动感和浅景深效果。她身着 一件修身浅灰色短款 T 恤、高腰浅蓝色牛仔短裤、白色短袜、厚底小白鞋，背着一个棕色细带单肩包。背景应呈现柔焦效果但清晰可辨：蓝灰色门板、石墙边缘、人行道，以及明亮的阳光和柔和的阴影。

在她周围环绕 5 张悬浮的半透明磨砂玻璃音乐 UI 卡片，仿佛智能手机应用面板脱离屏幕悬浮在物理空间中。所有卡片均为半透明深色磨砂玻璃材质，带有圆角、纤细的浅色轮廓、光泽反射、微妙的折射效果、真实的透视感，并在场景中投下淡淡的阴影。每张卡片包含专辑封面、曲目名称、艺术家姓名、进度条、时间戳、投屏图标以及白色极简风格的播放控制按钮。请按以下方式布置这 5 张卡片：1 张大型卡片位于左下角前景，最靠近镜头，呈透视倾斜，显示日落海洋专辑封面，文字为 Echoes in Waves，艺术家为 "Haycoon"，时长约 4:18；1 张中型卡片位于左上方，显示黑白花卉人像专辑封面，文字为 "Midnight Drive"，艺术家为 "Velora"；1 张中型卡片位于右上方，显示粉色云朵专辑封面，文字为 "Cloud Eight"，艺术家为 "Lume"；1 张中型竖版卡片位于右侧，显示黑白风中人像专辑封面，文字为 "Fading Signals"，艺术家为 "Noir"；1 张小型卡片位于右下角，显示蓝色抽象专辑封面，文字为 "Lumen"，艺术家为 "Astra"。确保悬浮面板与光影和透视完美融合，使其看起来真实存在于女性周围，而非平面的叠加层。

视觉风格：超写实真人摄影，创意商业广告美学，清晰的皮肤和织物细节，自然日光，柔和的镜头光晕，柔美虚化，真实阴影，高动态范围，非卡通风格。构图应强调深度：伸出的手在前景中显得较大且略微模糊，主体面部清晰，UI 卡片以不同距离悬浮在她周围。避免出现多余人物、多余 UI 卡片、水印、卡片外的标题、解剖结构畸变、无法辨认的乱码文字或纯图形样机效果。
